title: Count Good Nodes in Binary Tree
summary: Count nodes in a binary tree where no path from the root to the node contains a value greater than the node.
statement: Count nodes in a binary tree where no path from the root to the node contains a value greater than the node.
constraints: A node is good when no earlier node on its root-to-node path has a greater value.
The tree is non-empty and values may repeat.
